_comment: This is YOUR profile — the one the fork ships with so nothing is blank.
Editing this file is the whole job. No terminal, no Node.js, nothing to install:
1. Rename it to your username, e.g. profile-data/rahul.json
(username rules: 3-32 chars, letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore).
On GitHub: open the file, click the pencil, change the name in the box at
the top, edit, then Commit changes.
2. Change "username" below to match the filename exactly. Your URL is
/c/<filename>/, so the two have to agree — the filename wins if they don't,
and the home page will tell you.
3. Edit your links. "visibility" is "public" or "followers_only"; public links
show to anyone who scans the card, followers_only ones only for a temporary
token or an approved follower. Any other spelling is treated as hidden.
4. Add your username to the "profiles" list in profile-data/index.json, so your
card is listed on your home page.
Your permanent URL is /c/<username>/ — the home page shows it with a copy button
and a QR code beside it. You never have to type it, and it stays correct if you
move to a custom domain.
Optional, only if you have Node.js: `npm run build` pre-renders each
/c/<username>/ page and refreshes index.json for you, which lets you skip step 4.
Prefer a form? The dashboard/ and card-builder/ pages edit this same data with a
visual template picker, and export the JSON to paste back here.
Delete "_starter" when you are done; that flag is only how the site knows
to show you setup help instead of pretending this is a finished card.
Everything else here is documented in docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md.
tagline: One line people remember you by
